## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design multi-region, tenancy-aware architectures with DR and residency constraints; assesses knowledge of Aurora Global Database, RLS, read caching, analytics integration, and cost/latency trade-offs.

## Key Concepts


- How would you validate DR failover latency and RPO under peak load?
- What monitoring and cost controls would you implement to maintain SLAs across regions?
